verdict.rationale: Replit's docs describe built-in AI/LLM integrations (e.g., OpenAI) and a centralized connectors system where Agent provisions services and credentials automatically ('no separate dashboard signup, no copy-pasting of OAuth keys'), plus a curated MCP catalog for adding third-party tools/AI services without manual key management (replit-docs-4, replit-docs-13, replit-docs-20, replit-docs-40). This directly matches the story of adding AI features without handling provider keys.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that LLM-specific keys (e.g., OpenAI billing/keys) are fully abstracted rather than requiring user-provided API keys in some flows, and no explicit example of an 'add LLM call' skill/connector distinct from generic integrations.
